about_the_game:
Grab your friends, grab a flag, and try not to fall flat on your face! Raise the Colours is a satirical 4-player co-op physics game where your only mission is to fly as many flags as possible before the clock runs out.

Easy… until the local council shows up to shut you down.

Expect complete mayhem as you stumble, trip, and collide with each other in a desperate scramble to get those colours flying. The more you cooperate, the smoother it goes… but when has cooperation ever worked?

Features:

  • 4-player chaos – online multiplayer madness.

  • Physics-driven slapstick – carrying flags has never been harder (or funnier).

  • Not Allowed! – cones, barriers, and local council officials determined to ruin your fun.

  • Satirical pastiche – a tongue-in-cheek party game that doesn’t take itself seriously.

It’s dumb, it’s chaotic, it’s about raising flags against all odds. Raise the Colours is just a meme — play it for laughs, not for meaning.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 or AMD R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / RTX 2060, or AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

short_description: Raise the Colours is a satirical 4-player co-op physics game where you race to plant flags before the timer runs out. Work together (or trip each other up) while dodging pesky council workers who’ll do anything to shut down your fun. Not allowed!
